**What happened:** smoke→pilot→production chain launched detached on pod-2222 (branch issue-2222 tip 443209467c; bootstrap probe PASS, preflight ok=true 0 errors, GPU 0 MiB, sentinels cleared). The chain died in ~90 s at the SMOKE stage: `scripts/issue2222_stage.py` raised RuntimeError at line 234 in `reassert_parent_lineage` — "leg-A re-assertion FAILED — fresh branch-side commits with no plan disposition (artifact-reuse check (k))" — listing ~70 SHAs across issue-778 / issue-1739 / issue-825 for EVERY reused module, including files the plan §10 verified CLEAN (batch_judge.py, mapping_baselines.py, capture.py, store_io.py). Prior chain steps were healthy: dataset.zip staged + pin-verified (blob sha 4ae5f890b19e098cb51ab3ad55478343ba751588, 24 files), evil@16 subsample built, y-axis sparse-checkout add rc=0.

**Root cause (VERIFIED, not hypothesized):** the pod clone is SHALLOW (`git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → true; bootstrap_pod.sh clones depth-1). On a shallow clone, main's truncated ancestry makes the check's `git log --no-merges --format=%H origin/main..origin/<parent> -- <path>` attribute already-MERGED commits as branch-side. Verification on the VM full clone: (a) the identical range for `scripts/issue778_lib.py` returns exactly the plan's two dispositioned SHAs (3e1e1220d9, 3c295cd75e); (b) the same range for `src/explore_persona_space/eval/batch_judge.py` on issue-778 returns EMPTY (clean, matching the plan); (c) the pod-flagged "fresh" SHA a2b019934e77b4a44f4151e34f202edd838871a0 IS an ancestor of origin/main (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` → yes, i.e. merged). Known class: #779 — shallow pod clones break git-log fix-commit checks (agent memory feedback_shallow_clone_fix_commit_verification.md).

**Why code-class:** deterministic on every fresh pod — bootstrap always clones shallow, so an experimenter respawn hits the identical RuntimeError. The gate itself is behaving as written; the code's environment assumption (full history) is false on its own production lane.

**Recommended fix (experiment-implementer):** make `reassert_parent_lineage` shallow-aware — when `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` is true, deepen history before diffing (e.g. `git fetch --unshallow --filter=blob:none origin main <parent branches>`, commits+trees only, cheap enough for path-level `git log`), or post-filter flagged SHAs with `git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> origin/main` after the deepen; never fail-open (the check's own "never masquerade an errored probe as an empty diff" contract stands).

**Pod state (left ready for the fix round):** pod-2222 RUNNING and healthy — branch issue-2222 at 443209467c, preflight PASS, dataset.zip already staged + pin-verified under /workspace/explore-persona-space/data/issue_2222/, eval_results/issue_778 materialized via sparse-checkout add (163 files), GPU 0 MiB, chain PID 2710 confirmed dead, no stray driver procs, no EngineCore orphans. ## Headline

**The paper's three published data-screening predictors reproduce almost exactly on the released 24-dataset suite (all 9 arm×trait cells within ±0.10 of the published Qwen r; H3 PASS), but the frozen trait-agnostic context→answer map does NOT recover exact-ΔP predictivity: mapped ΔP underperforms even the paper's prompt-token identity assumption on every trait (H1 Inconclusive under the registered lattice, point estimate negative; H2 Falsified for all three traits).** Suggested title: "A frozen context→answer map fails to recover exact-ΔP data-screening predictivity, underperforming the paper's own prompt-token approximation on every trait (HIGH confidence)".

- **H1 (sycophancy gap): Inconclusive, direction NEGATIVE.** mapped_ctx r=0.319 vs prompt_dp r=0.559 at layer 19: Δr = −0.240. Three structural reads: (a) **mapped_ctx is statistically indistinguishable from the permutation null for sycophancy and hallucination at the verdict layer** and its max-over-28-layers |r| (0.414 syc, 0.229 halluc) sits BELOW even the max-selected null band p97.5 (0.57); (b) **mapped_pfx is degenerate exactly as pre-registered (#1739)** — the dataset rows carry no system prompt, so the prefix-end vector is constant, M(pfxend) shifts every row by a constant, and the arm equals raw to machine precision (identical r AND identical sample-level AUC) — never narrate it as "the prefix map matches raw"; (c) **the position identity plast≡ctxend holds in the data**: id_bias, the formalized prompt-token arm, tracks prompt_dp closely (0.935 vs 0.935; 0.531 vs 0.559; 0.674 vs 0.680), so the learned map is being compared against the identity assumption at the SAME captured position — the comparison is clean, and the identity assumption wins.

### Why the mapped arm fails (mechanism read, grounded)

- **The frozen #1739 map transfers catastrophically to this suite.** Held-out R² of the answer-representation prediction on issue-2222 rows: mapped_ctx −2121 at L19 (−1757 at L15), mapped_pfx −5843; identity −4.2, identity+bias −1.40 (`map_quality.json`). kNN retrieval of the true target among 3,000 held-out rows: acc@1 ≈ 0.001–0.0017 vs chance 0.00033, median rank ~1000–1150 — barely above chance. The map's predictions are wildly mis-scaled off-distribution: the sycophancy scatter shows mapped-ΔP dataset values spanning ~250–550 projection units where the raw arm spans ~15. The difference DV is therefore dominated by map error, not by the trait signal — sample-level AUC (misaligned_2 vs normal) collapses to 0.51–0.53 for mapped_ctx while every other arm reads 0.66–0.92.
- **In-distribution tuning does not rescue the hypothesis.** The exploratory tuned map (per-layer ridge ctxend→a(y_train) fit ON this suite, LOFO over 8 families, well-posed n_train_min=5250 > d=3584, dof-capped) reaches r_steer = 0.870 evil / 0.556 sycophancy / 0.642 hallucination — i.e. it roughly RECOVERS the prompt-token/identity arm (0.935/0.559/0.680) and still sits far below exact ΔP (0.946/0.881/0.577 — sycophancy gap ~0.32 remains). Even its best-case within-sample sweep (0.895 evil) never approaches exact-ΔP on sycophancy.
- **Interpretation:** the information exact ΔP adds — the base model's own generation, which the spot check shows is value-laden (it corrects fabricated premises and answers misaligned prompts benignly) — is not recovered by these linear context→answer maps at this layer: neither the frozen generic-corpus map nor a suite-tuned map with the training-response target closes the gap. The one linear read that DOES approach exact ΔP at forward-pass cost is the judge-supervised Form-A probe (below), which uses trait-label supervision the mapped arm deliberately avoids. Caveat: the tuned map's target here is the training-response representation a(y_train), not the base-generation representation a(y_base) — the direct linear surrogate of the exact stand-in is untested (follow-up 1).

Under leave-one-family-out with per-fold layer selection, the honest generalization ordering sharpens the story: exact ΔP is the ONLY forward-pass-era arm that generalizes across dataset families for sycophancy (LOFO r: exact 0.899 vs raw 0.140, prompt 0.435, id_bias 0.595, mapped_ctx 0.034). Evil is easy for everything but the mapped arm (raw 0.916, exact 0.947, prompt 0.886, mapped_ctx 0.538); hallucination is weak throughout (exact 0.603, raw 0.562, mapped_ctx −0.275). The paper's within-sample steering-layer numbers reproduce, but the LOFO companion shows the cheap published arms lean substantially on within-family interpolation for sycophancy. ## Headline

**The paper's three published data-screening predictors reproduce almost exactly on the released 24-dataset suite (all 9 arm×trait cells within ±0.10 of the published Qwen r; H3 PASS), but the frozen trait-agnostic context→answer map does NOT recover exact-ΔP predictivity: the H2 equivalence hypothesis is falsified as a three-trait conjunction — sycophancy alone rejects the registered −0.10 margin at every CI scheme — while the per-trait margin reads for evil (clustered grains only) and hallucination (frozen grains only; measured on a heavily drop-censored judge y, reduced weight) are grain-dependent. H1 is Inconclusive under the registered frozen-layer lattice, with a negative point estimate.** Suggested title: "A frozen context→answer map fails to recover exact-ΔP data-screening predictivity, and never beats the paper's own prompt-token approximation on any trait (point estimates) (HIGH confidence)".

### Why the mapped arm fails (mechanism read, grounded)

- **The frozen #1739 map transfers catastrophically to this suite.** Held-out R² of the answer-representation prediction on issue-2222 rows: mapped_ctx −2120 at L19 (−1757 at L15), mapped_pfx −5843; identity −4.2, identity+bias −1.40 (`map_quality.json`). kNN retrieval of the true target among 3,000 held-out rows: acc@1 ≈ 0.001–0.0017 vs chance 0.00033, median rank ~1000–1150 — barely above chance. The map's predictions are wildly mis-scaled off-distribution: the sycophancy scatter shows mapped-ΔP dataset values spanning ~250–550 projection units where the raw arm spans ~15. The difference DV is therefore dominated by map error, not by the trait signal — sample-level AUC (misaligned_2 vs normal) collapses to 0.51–0.53 for mapped_ctx while every other arm reads 0.66–0.92.
- **In-distribution tuning does not rescue the hypothesis — with a grid caveat.** The exploratory tuned map (per-layer ridge ctxend→a(y_train) fit ON this suite, LOFO over 8 families, well-posed n_train_min=5250 > d=3584, dof-capped) reaches r_steer = 0.870 evil / 0.556 sycophancy / 0.642 hallucination — i.e. it roughly RECOVERS the prompt-token/identity arm (0.935/0.559/0.680) and still sits far below exact ΔP on sycophancy (0.881; gap ~0.32). Two qualifiers: (i) the ridge λ selector saturates at the grid boundary — selected λ ∈ {3162, 10000} across all 28 layers × 8 folds, 203/224 fits at the grid max 10000 — so the selector wants MORE shrinkage than the grid offers and the tuned-map read is potentially grid-limited (the Form-A probe grid extends to 1e6; this is tuned-map-specific); a wider-grid refit rides follow-up 1. (ii) Under per-fold layer selection the tuned map's honest-generalization companion sign-flips for hallucination: `lofo_r = −0.118` vs r_steer 0.642 (evil 0.851, sycophancy 0.529 hold up). Even the tuned map's best within-sample sweep point (0.895, evil L23) never approaches exact ΔP on sycophancy.
- **Interpretation:** the information exact ΔP adds — the base model's own generation, which the spot check shows is value-laden (it corrects fabricated premises and answers misaligned prompts benignly) — is not recovered by these linear context→answer maps at this layer: neither the frozen generic-corpus map nor a suite-tuned map with the training-response target closes the gap. The one linear read that DOES approach exact ΔP at forward-pass cost is the judge-supervised Form-A probe (below), which uses trait-label supervision the mapped arm deliberately avoids. Caveat: the tuned map's target here is the training-response representation a(y_train), not the base-generation representation a(y_base) — the direct linear surrogate of the exact stand-in is untested (follow-up 1).
